conviction_note: The fall has an identified, dated, non-informational cause: SCTX entered the Russell 2000/3000 at the 2026-09-21 open, and the index print cleared at the 2026-09-18 close on 2,236,400 shares ($73.8m, 13x the $5.7m 20-day median and ~23% of the 9.87m freely tradable shares) against 137k-330k on every other September session; the 09-21 collapse took the stock through its pre-index level ($28.05 against closes of $29.42 on 09-14 and $29.10 on 09-16), so the round trip is complete and the buyer that set the price is a permanent holder. Against that, nothing was disclosed - no SEC filing since 2026-09-02, no press release since 2026-09-02, no analyst action, no ATM in the register ever, cash guided into 1H 2029. Sum of findings is +3.5; I emit +1.8, 1.7 points lower, because the close printed near the session low ($28.05 against a $27.32 low and a $34.49 high), the intraday shape rallied before it broke which is not what a pure index unwind looks like, ATR14 is 12.1% and the free ranker says high-ATR fallers keep falling, and the cross-sectional prior for this band is -0.30%.
bar: This name's own two comparable falls, both of which bounced (2026-08-13 -11.47% then +1.77%; 2026-08-25 -16.21% then +1.57%; median next close +1.67%, up-rate 2 of 2) from the sealed baseline history block; and the observed pre-index price level, the 2026-09-14 close of $29.42 and the 2026-09-16 close of $29.10, from Yahoo daily bars truncated at the drop-day close (https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/SCTX?range=3mo&interval=1d). No implied move exists - the baseline reports no_options_market - so every size here is bounded by the name's own reaction history rather than by a chain.

cause.label: index_or_flow
cause.what_happened: SCTX was one of the September 2026 Russell quarterly IPO additions, effective at the 2026-09-21 market open, so index trackers bought at the 2026-09-18 close - 2,236,400 shares and $73.8m against a $5.7m 20-day median - and on Monday 09-21 the stock opened at $32.88, ran to $34.49 and then fell all day to close at $28.05, one tick above its $27.32 low, on 528,600 shares, roughly a quarter of Friday's print and with no filing, press release or analyst action behind it.

Independent confirmation of the same effective date and convention from another added issuer: Evolution Metals & Technologies joined the Russell 3000 and Russell 2000 'effective as of the opening of U.S. equity markets on Monday, September 21, 2026'

No 8-K, no press release and no other filing of any kind since 2026-09-02, confirmed by re-pulling the SEC's own submissions feed inside the predicted session

pipeline.next_dated_event: 2026-09-25 - the outside date of the four-business-day 8-K clock for any reportable event of 2026-09-21, with nothing filed as of 2026-09-22 12:56 ET; the next company-scheduled event is the Cell & Gene Meeting on the Mesa, Phoenix AZ, 2026-10-05 at 5:15 PM MT, and initial STX-1150 Phase 1 SAD data is guided to 1H 2027

positioning_check: 778,191 shares short at the 2026-08-31 FINRA settlement, up 173.3% from 284,711 at 2026-08-14, days to cover 2.63 on a 295,438-share ADV (https://api.nasdaq.com/api/quote/SCTX/short-interest?assetclass=stocks). That is about 7.9% of the 9,867,000 freely tradable shares of 17,577,386 outstanding after the IPO, the full over-allotment and the Sanofi private placement (424B4, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1853921/000119312526316503/d21355d424b4.htm). FINRA publishes about eight business days after settlement, so the 2026-09-15 settlement is not out until roughly 2026-09-25 and the position carried into the index print and into the fall is NOT observable. Insiders: 11 open-market buys and 0 sells over 3 and 12 months (https://api.nasdaq.com/api/company/SCTX/insider-trades). No options market exists, so there is no skew to read.

findings.finding: The buyer that made the price is a dated index trade that has already cleared, and the 2026-09-21 session completed a full round trip back through the pre-index level - SCTX joined the Russell 2000/3000 at the 09-21 open, trackers bought 2,236,400 shares ($73.8m, 13x the $5.7m 20-day median) at the 2026-09-18 close, and the $28.05 drop-day close is now 4.7% BELOW the 2026-09-14 close of $29.42 and 3.6% below the 2026-09-16 close of $29.10.
findings.mechanism_in_window: The index trade cleared at a known close, 2026-09-18, and the arbitrage position built into it was worked out in the 2026-09-21 session - 528,600 shares, a quarter of Friday's print - taking the price through the level it started from. Index funds are permanent holders and do not sell, so from the 2026-09-22 open there is no index-related supply at any date and the free float available to trade is smaller than it was on 09-17. The non-informational flow that made both the run-up and the give-back is therefore dated and finished, and the next session is the first one with neither side of it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This name has no prior index event. Its own two comparable falls both bounced the next close: 2026-08-13 -11.47% then +1.77%, 2026-08-25 -16.21% then +1.57%, median +1.67%, 2 of 2 up (sealed baseline history block, 3-year lookback on observed daily closes).
findings.why_not_priced: The price has taken the give-back; what it has not taken is that the give-back is over. On 2026-09-21 the tape could not tell a flow unwind from an undisclosed event, and it closed one tick off the low as if it were the latter. If it had held that the cause was the index round trip, the close would have stopped at the pre-index $29.1-$29.4 rather than 4% through it, and the day would not have printed its low in the last hour. Nothing about the company changed between 09-17 and 09-21.
findings.independence: The volume record is a second, independent source and it is not an opinion: 2,236,400 shares on 2026-09-18 against 137,000-326,000 on every other session of the month, from Yahoo daily bars truncated at the drop-day close (https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/SCTX?range=3mo&interval=1d). A third: Evolution Metals' own release names the identical 2026-09-21 market-open effective date for the same quarterly addition (https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/09/21/3365486/0/en/evolution-metals-technologies-corp-joins-russell-3000-and-russell-2000-indexes-gaining-exposure-to-12-2-trillion-in-benchmarked-assets.html). The ticker-level list itself is a secondary aggregator - FTSE Russell's own PDF downloads but its text is subset-font encoded and could not be decoded here.

findings.finding: Nothing was disclosed behind the fall and the balance sheet offers no second leg: no SEC filing of any kind since the 2026-09-02 10-Q and Item 2.02 8-K, no press release since 2026-09-02, no analyst action found around 09-21, zero 'at-the-market' hits ever in this issuer's full-text filing history, zero 'minimum bid price' and zero 'non-reliance' hits, and $43.0m of cash at 30 June plus ~$140.6m of net IPO proceeds guided to fund operations into the first half of 2029.
findings.mechanism_in_window: The absence is checkable overnight and by anyone, on the SEC's own submissions feed and the company's newsroom, where the intraday tape on 09-21 had to price the live possibility that a disclosure was coming. I re-pulled data.sec.gov at 2026-09-22 12:56 ET and it still shows nothing since 2026-09-02. Each session that passes without a filing removes probability mass from that possibility, and the going-concern language that appears in the pre-IPO S-1 and 424B4 does not recur in the post-IPO 10-Q.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The last time this issuer put a document in front of the market - the Q2 release and 10-Q of 2026-09-02 - the stock closed +3.7% that day at $30.90 on 278,700 shares and gave it back over the following two sessions to $28.67; its document-driven moves have been an order of magnitude smaller than 15%.
findings.why_not_priced: The price has taken a 15% fall; it has not taken the fact that two days of filing history contain nothing to justify one. What the overnight reader can verify that the intraday tape could not is that there is no ATM to be drawn tonight, no covenant, no listing clock, no restatement item and no funding need before 2029 - i.e. that every one of the usual second legs is absent from the register. If the market had held that, the close would not have been at the low of the day.
findings.independence: The company's own newsroom is a separate source and is unchanged since 2026-09-02 (https://www.scribetx.com/newsroom). The full-text probes in the sealed baseline agree independently: shelf_or_atm 0 hits ever, listing_deficiency 0, restatement 0. The Q2 runway sentence is quoted in the release itself (https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/09/02/3355504/0/en/scribe-therapeutics-reports-second-quarter-2026-financial-results-and-recent-corporate-highlights.html).

findings.finding: The four-business-day 8-K clock on any 2026-09-21 reportable event is still running to 2026-09-25, and the drop-day's intraday shape argues against attributing all of the fall to flow: the stock opened at $32.88, rallied 4.6% to $34.49, and only then fell 21% to a $27.32 low, which is not the from-the-open weakness an index unwind produces.
findings.mechanism_in_window: 2026-09-22 is the second of the four business days, so a disclosure of a 09-21 event can land any time inside the window, before or during the session. This is the residual probability that my leg-1 reading is wrong, priced rather than ignored, and it is why the two legs are reported apart.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This issuer has filed two 8-Ks since listing - 2026-07-27 (Items 5.03, 9.01) and 2026-09-02 (Items 2.02, 9.01) - and neither was a negative surprise; there is no instance of an unscheduled 8-K from this company to score against.
findings.why_not_priced: The price has taken the fall itself. What it cannot have taken is the content of a document that does not exist yet: if a disclosure lands on 09-22 the 09-21 close will look like the first half of a repricing rather than a completed round trip. If the market had already held a specific pending disclosure, the 09-21 session would not have traded up 4.6% in its first hours.
findings.independence: none - this is the absence of a document, corroborated only by its own absence at 2026-09-22 12:56 ET on https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK0001853921.json

Initial STX-1150 Phase 1 single-ascending-dose data - safety, tolerability and LDL-C lowering - guided to the first half of 2027; two-sided binary, not signed here
CEO Benjamin Oakes presents at the Cell & Gene Meeting on the Mesa, Phoenix AZ, 2026-10-05 at 5:15 PM MT - the next company-scheduled appearance of any kind

ADARx Pharmaceuticals filed an S-1/A on 2026-09-21 that names Scribe Therapeutics - a competing cardiometabolic genetic-medicine IPO being marketed into the same investor pocket - but its pricing date is not established, so it carries no date inside the window
The next FINRA short-interest publication, for the 2026-09-15 settlement, is due about 2026-09-25 and is the first observation of the position carried into the index print and the fall

searched_and_found_nothing: CONTAMINATION, declared: this is a hand-run inside the predicted session (approximately 2026-09-22 13:00 ET), not a scheduled fire. A MarketBeat headline dated 2026-09-22 stating a same-day percentage move for SCTX appeared unbidden in search results, as did a quote-widget 'current price' figure. Both were discarded and neither entered any number, any finding or any part of the reasoning above. Every price used here is dated 2026-09-21 or earlier and the daily-bar pull was hard-truncated at the drop-day close in code.

A secondary source (https://insidersignals.substack.com/p/scribe-therapeutics-the-64-million) claims the lock-up expires 2026-09-28, which would have put a supply release four business days outside the window. The primary 424B4 contradicts it in three places - 'The lock-up agreements pertaining to this offering will expire 180 days from the date of this prospectus', prospectus dated 2026-07-23 - and no '180 days' construction in that document yields September. The claim was dropped, not used.
No SEC filing of any kind between 2026-09-03 and 2026-09-22 12:56 ET (https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK0001853921.json): no 8-K, no 13D/A, no 13G/A, no Form 4, no Form 144.

No company press release since 2026-09-02 (https://www.scribetx.com/newsroom); the 2026-09-01 conference release lists only Wells Fargo 09-09, H.C. Wainwright 09-15 and Meeting on the Mesa 10-05, so there was no company event on or into 09-21.

No analyst action found dated near 2026-09-21; the coverage that exists was initiated mid-August (Leerink Outperform $37, Guggenheim Buy $50, Wells Fargo Overweight $60) plus H.C. Wainwright Buy $60 on 2026-08-31.
No termination, pause or renegotiation of the Sanofi or Eli Lilly collaborations found on any wire or in any filing.

The obvious sector candidate does not fit the date: Cellectis's pivot to in vivo gene editing with HEAL-201, epigenetic PCSK9 silencing - the closest competitive read-through to STX-1150 - was announced 2026-09-14 (https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/09/14/3360712/0/en/cellectis-announces-strategic-transformation-to-in-vivo-gene-editing-company.html), a week before the fall, not on it.

No short report, no going-concern event and no listing issue: efts full-text over this CIK returns 0 hits ever for 'at-the-market', 0 for 'minimum bid price' and 0 for 'non-reliance', and the 'substantial doubt' language stops at the pre-IPO 424B4 of 2026-07-27.
Only two filings by anyone mention Scribe Therapeutics between 2026-09-15 and 2026-09-22, both competitor IPO documents: Electra Therapeutics 424B4 (2026-09-18) and ADARx S-1/A (2026-09-21).
No trial readout is near: the single registered study, NCT07428473 (STX-1150 Phase 1), is RECRUITING with primary completion 2028-12-30 (https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT07428473).
CourtListener could not be checked - the v4 search API returned HTTP 429, 'Rate limit exceeded: 125/day' - so no federal docket or securities-class-action check was completed for this name.

FTSE Russell's own final IPO additions list (https://www.lseg.com/content/dam/ftse-russell/en_us/documents/other/final-ipo-additions-3-qtr-r3000.pdf) downloads at HTTP 200 but its text is drawn with subset fonts and no ToUnicode map, so it could not be decoded in this container; the ticker-level confirmation for SCTX therefore rests on a secondary aggregator plus the volume signature and another added issuer's own release.

Nasdaq's Listing Center, FTSE Russell's index notices and Nasdaq's press-release topic API are all unreachable from here per the sealed baseline, so no index deletion or deficiency notice is asserted anywhere above.
baseline_tension: Mixed, and the disagreement is the reason the emitted number is 1.7 points below the sum of the findings: the evidence agrees with this name's own reaction function (both comparable falls of the last three years bounced, +1.77% and +1.57%, median +1.67%, 2 of 2) and with the modest 2.75x volume spike, which sits at the benign end of the base rate where under-2x fallers average +1.46%, but it cuts against the 12.1% ATR14 - the best free ranker in phase 0 says high-ATR fallers keep falling - against the -0.30% cross-sectional prior for this drop and turnover band, against a close that printed one tick off the session low, and against an intraday shape that rallied 4.6% before it broke, which is not the from-the-open weakness a clean index unwind produces.
